verdict.rationale: Ellis Porter is an immigration law firm offering attorney-led petition services, so user-defined automation rules that fire actions on events are a category error for this kind of product. Its client portal is documented only for document sharing, messaging and case-status tracking. Its expiration tracking is a service performed by staff, not a rules engine the user configures.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
